title: ActionLine
description: One line of actions.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one call JavaScript made to the capture module, with what native code returned. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases, and args and result parse as JSON.

t.description: When native code answered the call.

call.description: The method's name, for example markAnchor.

args.description: The arguments as JavaScript passed them, as JSON text (an array).

result.description: What native code returned, as JSON text, or null for nothing.

error.description: The error's code when the call failed, else null.
